files.doc: /** 🗳️ The fixture schema, committer law and proposal geometry checks of the GIS Map proposal approval fixture proof. */

phases.name: checkProposalFixtureSchema
phases.doc: Loads the proposal approval fixture and checks its schema, binding, limits, preview and lifecycle kinds.

phases.name: checkCommitterLawTables
phases.doc: Checks the scalar and ordered committer law tables and the fixture row counts.

phases.name: checkProposalHashAndGeometry
phases.doc: Checks the proposal and inverse hashes, the created region, the base bounds and the lifecycle transitions.

files.doc: /** 🛡️ The visibility, error status, committer ledger and committer source checks of the GIS Map proposal approval fixture proof. */

phases.name: checkVisibilityErrorsAndCommitterLedger
phases.doc: Checks the role visibility rows, the error statuses and the committer ledger rows.

phases.name: checkRetainedRuntimeSources
phases.doc: Checks the retained GIS Map runtime, binding, wal and sqlite sources.

files.doc: /** 🚪️ The hub ingress, frozen binary and process source checks of the GIS Map proposal approval fixture proof. */

phases.name: checkHubIngressSources
phases.doc: Checks the hub approval ingress, handler, teardown and registration sources.

phases.name: checkProcessSources
phases.doc: Checks the compiled process runner source and its hostile mutations.
